mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id AS reportId, r.diary_id AS diaryId, r.reason, r.status, r.resolution, r.admin_note AS adminNote, reporter.name AS reporterName, reporter.email AS reporterEmail, author.name AS authorName, p.name AS petName, d.content, d.visibility, d.deleted_at AS deletedAt, i.inquiry_number AS inquiryNumber, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.resolved_at AS resolvedAt FROM diary_report r JOIN care_diary d ON d.diary_id = r.diary_id JOIN pet p ON p.pet_id = d.pet_id JOIN member reporter ON reporter.member_id = r.reporter_id JOIN member author ON author.member_id = d.author_member_id LEFT JOIN inquiry i ON i.inquiry_id = r.inquiry_id WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId}
